Here’s a quick snapshot of key players who have worn the Los Angeles Clippers jersey—both past legends and the current lineup (as of the 2025‑26 season). If you’re looking for a specific era or a deeper dive into a particular player’s stats, just let me know!

| Era | Notable Players | Notes |
|-----|-----------------|-------|
| **Early Years (1970s‑80s)** | *Kenny Smith*, *Moses Malone*, *Bill Walton* | The Clippers were originally the Buffalo Braves before moving to San Diego and finally LA. |
| **1990s** | *Gary Payton*, *Danny Manning*, *Julius Erving* (short stint) | Payton’s defensive prowess helped raise the franchise’s profile. |
| **2000s** | *Pau Gasol*, *Chris Webber*, *Jamal Crawford*, *Kobe Bryant* (brief stint) | Gasol’s arrival marked a turning point; Crawford was a prolific scorer. |
| **2010s** | *Chris Paul*, *Kawhi Leonard*, *Paul George*, *DeAndre Jordan*, *Julius Randle* | The “Lob City” era (2013‑2016) featured high‑flying dunks and playoff runs. |
| **2020s (Current Roster)** | *Paul George*, *Julius Randle*, *Kawhi Leonard*, *Jalen Green*, *Jabari Smith Jr.*, *Julius Randle*, *Jalen Green*, *Jabari Smith Jr.*, *Jalen Green*, *Jabari Smith Jr.* | The Clippers are building a mix of veteran talent and young prospects. |
| **All‑Time Legends** | *Kenny Smith*, *Gary Payton*, *Chris Paul*, *Kawhi Leonard*, *Paul George*, *Julius Randle*, *Jalen Green* | These players have left a lasting impact on the franchise. |

### Current 2025‑26 Roster Highlights
- **Paul George** – 6‑time All‑Star, 2‑time Defensive Player of the Year.
- **Julius Randle** – 3‑time All‑Star, 2020‑21 MVP of the NBA G League.
- **Jalen Green** – 2023‑24 Rookie of the Year, 2024‑25 All‑Star.
- **Jabari Smith Jr.** – 2024‑25 Rookie of the Year, 2025‑26 All‑Star.
- **Kawhi Leonard** – 7‑time All‑Star, 2‑time Finals MVP.

Feel free to ask for more details on any player, their career stats, or how the Clippers’ roster has evolved over the years!
